initialPrompts: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: 2D fighting game animation sprite sheet. Input reference: the attached Dr Styro sheet is the EXACT character design and inked comic art to preserve. Create a NEW clean sprite atlas with 16 WHOLE BODY drawings, exactly 4 equal columns by 4 equal rows, transparent background, 2048x2048 if possible. Every figure is fully inside its own 512x512 cell, same scale, grounded feet at same baseline, no labels/grid/borders/ground/shadow. Character faces SCREEN LEFT in three-quarter fighting stance, like reference. Keep HALF HUMAN face with brown swept hair and blue goggle lens, other half WHITE bumpy styrofoam face with red eye and sinister grin; ragged white lab coat, black ripped trousers, human black boot and oversized foam leg, enormous bumpy foam arm. DO NOT swap his human and foam sides between frames. Keep detailed painted comic shading and black ink outlines, no red fringe. Frames row-major: Row 1 frames 0-3 first half of coherent walking cycle: left contact, down/compression, passing, up. Row 2 frames 4-7 second half of SAME walking cycle: opposite contact, down, passing, up; visibly alternate which foot leads, body roughly same height, boots planted during contact, no sliding or duplicated poses. Row 3 frames 8-11 subtle four-pose breathing idle cycle, knees flexed, hands in guard, small coat movement. Row 4: frame12 light hit recoil leaning chest/head backward, frame13 heavy body hit bent at waist with foam arm guarding body, frame14 staggering back knee compressed human hand reaching for balance, frame15 recovering into neutral guard. Keep same character proportions and whole figure, extra empty space around each sprite; no impact graphics, text, debris outside cells.
